title: Mutation: Unjustified Non-Applicability

revision_history.author: safety_engineer
revision_history.description: Corrected the patch to write the marking into the field the schema declares. requirement.schema.json enumerates 'not_applicable' as a value of safety_allocation.asil, so non-applicability is expressible in this data model and the requirement applicability validator reads it from there. The previous patch set an undeclared top-level 'applicability' key; nothing in the schemas declares that property as meaning anything and no rule read it, so the scenario asserted a defect no detector could observe. No new field was introduced and safety_allocation was not extended - its additionalProperties is false and the justification is read from asil_justification, the field the corpus already uses for this purpose on safety goals. The scenario's intent, declared detector and expected severity are unchanged. Remediation of finding FB2-REV-FND-000032.

patch.description: Mark safety requirement FB2-SAF-FSR-000004 as not applicable to ASIL determination without recording why. The marking is written to safety_allocation.asil, whose value 'not_applicable' requirement.schema.json itself enumerates; the previous version of this patch set an undeclared top-level 'applicability' key, which no schema declares and no rule reads, so the patch could not have been detected by any rule however the rule was written.

expected_finding.description: requirement FB2-SAF-FSR-000004 is marked not applicable (safety_allocation.asil) without an asil_justification recording why no ASIL determination applies to it

impact_paths: Critical safety function may be omitted from verification
expected_remediation: Record an asil_justification stating why no ASIL determination applies to this requirement, or restore the ASIL allocation; re-run the requirement applicability validator
